does: Takes one drawn die and the roll type; for every MaximumRollResult boost of that type on the roller lowers the die to its Result, for every MinimumRollResult boost raises it to its Result. A boost of an umbrella roll type covers the rolls under it.

evidence.says: With MinimumRollResult and MaximumRollResult (SkillCheck,20) on the host, GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's count saw both draws run (0 to 1, 1 to 2) and the check came 20/20 instead of the stream's 9/11 at count 0; this is the only function called on each drawn die between the draw and the keeping of one (read in +0x105CCA0). A read watch on the boost's Result closed the game twice, so no read hit backs it. Independently: GK.Memory.Freeze of the Result (+0x1) of the host's attack pin's two boosts from 19 to 2 made the next fair melee attack miss plainly where 19 hit, and the function reads exactly those two components
